name: Yumi
tagline: A social network that learns your taste from casual reviews and finds restaurants a whole group will like.
problem: Visitors and groups struggle to pick food beyond chain results.
solution: Gemini extracts flavour, atmosphere and price preferences from natural-language reviews into taste profiles; tagging friends merges their profiles and function calling searches and ranks restaurants; voice queries work too.
demo_moment: Team-described: tag two friends and get a ranked pick for all three.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “3rd Best Overall Hack” among 160 submissions.
Solves the group decision, not one person's search.

lessons: Pick the group version of a solo problem.
